_about: Public-domain Isaac of Nineveh (Isaac the Syrian, 7th century), bishop and ascetic of the Church of the East, for the Word Hoard: Mystic Treatises by Isaac of Nineveh, translated from Bedjan's Syriac text by A. J. Wensinck (Amsterdam: Royal Academy, 1923), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
